description: Parity oracle corpus for the frozen TS icon compositor (ADR-0019 M0b).

parity.decode: Pure node:zlib inflate + PNG un-filter (colortype 6 / 8-bit / no interlace). No colour management; straight alpha. Verified byte-identical to PIL and the browser canvas on the mock pack.
parity.encode: Deterministic: Paeth per-scanline filter + zlib deflate level 9. Proven by capture-twice byte-diff.
parity.note: Byte-comparison in --verify is on DECODED RGBA pixels (platform-independent), not PNG container bytes. The per-cell rasterHash is sha256 of decoded RGBA and is the canonical parity anchor for the M5 tri-target differential.

shortcutArrow.note: Loaded at native 100² and composited by drawClassicArrow exactly as the app worker does at boot; shortcut/Keep goldens carry the real badge, not the vector fallback. The Rust port must composite the same asset.
